key_insight: AdsMind is a closed-loop, physics-grounded multi-agent system that uses MLFF relaxation feedback to self-correct adsorption-configuration guesses and reliably find low-energy surface-adsorbate structures.
engineering_relevance: It can substantially reduce the costly search burden in heterogeneous catalysis workflows while improving robustness and interpretability for DFT-informed autonomous discovery.
method: MLFF relaxation feedback detects and corrects erroneous guesses in a closed loop
Multi-backend evaluation supports self-consistent, high-reliability search
evidence_signal: On AA20 and OCD-GMAE62, AdsMind reached 100% and 98.8% success, used only 4.11 and 4.67 MLFF relaxations per case, and DFT validation on six AA20 systems showed better sign correctness than the open-loop baseline.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality and transferability of the MLFF/relaxation feedback, so failures may still occur when the surrogate force field is inaccurate outside the tested chemistry.
paper_title: AdsMind: A Physics-Grounded Multi-Agent System for Self-Correcting Discovery of Adsorption Configurations on Heterogeneous Catalyst Surfaces
